content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Auto-detect: Hosted API queue growth in us-east-1 across gen-text models. p95 latency ↑ 3.2x, p99 ↑ 5.8x, queued requests = 128,432. Error rate (504) spike from 0.1% -> 6.7%. Threshold: queue > 50k. Paging priya_oncall
priya_oncall: seeing it. grabbing graphs now. which pools are hot?
liam_sre: gpu-provisioner logs show repeated create failures 10:02-10:12 due to quota throttles -> instance create retry loop. provisioning backlog ~18k requests waiting for new workers.
vikram_infra: confirmed. cloud provider returned RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED on vm create at ~10:05 across multiple AZs. quota still reports free but provisioning API rejecting due to 'regional throttle'.
elaine_prod: customers reporting slow completions and timeouts. CS flagged two enterprise tenants with high-volume sync jobs; SLA alerts fired.
priya_oncall: ops-bot, can you reroute traffic and enable degraded-mode fallback? we need to reduce pressure on hosted pools while we remediate provisioner.
ops-bot: Executing runbook: hosted-fallback-route -> enabling model-variant fallback (quantized-slim) for non-enterprise routes. Commands:
```
# apply fallback routing
rbx route set --region us-east-1 --rule "if queue>20000 and not enterprise: use quantized-slim"
rbx model set --id=gen-text-v2 --fallback=gen-text-v2-quant --priority=low
```
ops-bot: Fallback routing applied. Non-enterprise traffic ~57% of total; estimate immediate load drop ~45%.
liam_sre: also throttling inbound per-client RPS at edge for large API keys for 15m window to flatten burst:
```
edgectl rate-limit --scope=api-key --limit=200rps --duration=15m
```
vikram_infra: creating support ticket with cloud provider for regional provisioning throttle. In the meantime, suggest manual pool add in us-west-2 and cross-region failover.
priya_oncall: can someone trigger emergency pool creation in us-west-2 using reserved templates? we have spare reserved GPU capacity there.
liam_sre: spinning up 8 reserved-gpu instances in us-west-2 using existing reserved pool template. `provisioner create --template reserved-gpu-rtx-8 --count 8 --region us-west-2`
(approx ETA for readiness ~ 6-9 mins)
elaine_prod: notifying impacted enterprise customers: "We are mitigating an infrastructure issue causing higher latency and intermittent timeouts in us-east-1. Traffic has been routed to fallback models where safe; we expect gradual recovery as we bring up additional capacity. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause."
priya_oncall: handoff to liam_sre for active mitigation; I'll remain as incident lead for customer comms. liam, take primary pager.
liam_sre: taking pager. current mitigation summary: 1) applied model fallback for non-enterprise 2) inbound rate-limits for large keys 3) provisioning spare capacity in us-west-2 4) cloud provider ticket opened. watching queue metric.
incident-bot: Update: us-west-2 pool instances reporting healthy and joining runtime at 10:21. New capacity servicing ~34k queued requests (shifted via smart routing). Queue in us-east-1 reduced to 46,300. p95 now trending down.
vikram_infra: provider responded: temporary regional throttles were triggered by upstream rate-limiter due to control-plane surge; they lifted limits at 10:20 and marked as resolved. We'll still file for quota increase and longer-term backoff strategy.
priya_oncall: good. liam, do you want to run a graceful retry purge for stuck requests older than 120s? we should avoid hammering newly provisioned workers.
liam_sre: running controlled retry window: `queuectl retry --age-gt 120 --rate 1000/s --dry-run=false`
ops-bot: Retried ~9,400 requests; success rate 92%. 504s continuing to fall.
elaine_prod: CS updated customers with recovery note. Enterprise tenants saw reduced errors after fallback; one tenant with synchronous workloads requested temporary dedicated capacity — DM'd sales.
liam_sre: putting autoscaler on manual control to avoid oscillation while we evaluate failover logic: `autoscale set --mode manual --note "incident 4412345678"`
priya_oncall: starting incident timeline notes for postmortem. action items: - provider quota follow-up - improve autoscaler backoff - add regional pre-warm policy for high-fanout endpoints - playbook update for threshold 50k queue.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. last observation: queue total 13,210; p99 back to 1.6x baseline. Escalation cleared at 10:45.
priya_oncall: thanks team. liam, please own the postmortem and link runbook + timeline. I'll coordinate customer comms. brief oncall handoff at 11:00 to vikram_infra.
liam_sre: will do. logging relevant artifacts: provisioning logs, autoscaler traces, edge rate-limit policy, model-fallback config.
vikram_infra: will follow up with cloud provider contact and request quota bump + rate-limit exemption for critical templates.
priya_oncall: closing channel for active mitigation. add any follow-ups in the incident tracker and schedule a 1-hour blameless postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
